Part B Script (to be read)
Invented texts. Three songs, each to read twice with 30 Second pause. 1 · Talk show (fuṣḥā spoken with passages to the Egyptian; Egyptian parts are without vowels).
⁧شُكْرًا عَلَى الاِسْتِضَافَةِ. تُشِيرُ الأَرْقَامُ الرَّسْمِيَّةُ إِلَى أَنَّ بِطَالَةَ الشَّبَابِ بَلَغَتْ خَمْسَةً وَعِشْرِينَ فِي المِئَةِ.⁩
⁧يعني من كل أربع شباب، واحد قاعد في البيت من غير شغل. وده مش رقم، دي حكايات ناس!⁩
⁧وَلِذٰلِكَ أَقْتَرِحُ بَرْنَامَجًا لِلتَّدْرِيبِ المِهْنِيِّ، بِالتَّعَاوُنِ مَعَ الشَّرِكَاتِ الخَاصَّةِ.⁩

A · Reading
1. A national plan to regulate foreign labour: two-year work permits for workers
seasonal farming, with annual quotas. Precisely: biennial permits for seasonal agriculture (who, what, duration). To be defined: the size of allowances, start-up times, numbers.
2. ⁧الاستعارة:⁩ « ⁧موجات⁩ … ⁧تغرق⁩ (Migrations as submerge water: image of threat); ⁧التثليث⁩ :
« ⁧منظمة، ومحمية، ومفيدة للجميع⁩ (completeness, positive balance). The implicit contrast between waves and organized labour is also evident.
3. "Wave', "submerge', "illegal', human rights associations: these words criminalize the
migrants and present them as a threat. They propose irregular migration, which describes the administrative situation and does not make the person an infringement.
4. The hashtag is at the top of the trend. foreign workers have posted videos in which

tell of their experience. The verification site has established that the data is not based on any published study and that the latest report of the statistical institute does not link unemployment with foreign labour. In a report: • The Minister said, without mentioning sources, that one third of the unemployed lost their jobs because of foreign competition; According to a verification site, the data is not based on published studies.
5. In a variety with Egyptian traits (or however in dialect, not in fuṣḥā): ⁧كويسة، إحنا، محتاجين، دول، مش،⁩
⁧بكرة⁩ . For a report: .[in dialect, with Egyptian traits] "The plan is fine, but we need these workers from tomorrow, not next year" . There is nothing deduced on the person other than traits.
B · Listening
1. Youth unemployment (25%, according to official data). Switch to the Egyptian for the concrete example (
young in four is at home without work back to fuṣḥā for the proposal. A vocational training programme in collaboration with private companies.
2. Trash in the streets. The representative of the municipality: the collecting company stopped because it is not paid by

three months; The city is treating and will find a solution this week. The representative of the inhabitants: the smell is unbearable and children get sick; It's not people's fault. No real agreement: the representative grants () ⁧معك حق⁩ (ii) but cannot pay; You remain sceptical ('we have already heard these words').
3. An application for booking visits to public hospitals clinics. Objective: to avoid hours of
tail; cost: about one million pounds in the first year; challenges: not everyone has a smartphone, so you also need a phone line. « ⁧وأنا تحت أمر حضراتكم لأي سؤال⁩ ».

⁧فِي وَضْعٍ غَيْرِ نِظَامِيٍّ خِلَالَ أُسْبُوعٍ، بِحَسَبِ السُّلُطَاتِ المَحَلِّيَّةِ.⁩ · 6. ⁧أَنْتَقِلُ الآنَ إِلَى النُّقْطَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ وَالأَخِيرَةِ.⁩ · 7. ⁧المُقَابَلَة⁩

(antithesis) · 8. The newspaper reported, citing a source that did not want to reveal its identity, that the meeting was postponed. 9. It hasn't arrived yet, it'll come later. 10. 1200 ryal = 60 Dirham.
D · Translation · Example

Excellencies, ambassadors, ladies and gentlemen, today we inaugurate this center not because it is just a new building, but because it is a home for anyone seeking knowledge. We have learned that nations are not built with stones, but with minds; They do not defend themselves with walls, but with schools. In its first year the centre will welcome five thousand students, and we will work to make it a reference point for scientific research in the region within five years. Do our children not have the right to learn in their own country what others are going to learn abroad? Yes, and that's why we're here today. Thanks to those who have worked, to those who believed, to those who had patience. ⁧معالي⁩ , ⁧سعادة⁩ ); the two parallel antithesis; ⁧سنسعى⁩ made as an intention ('we will work'), not as a sure promise; the rhetorical question with ⁧بلى⁩ ; the series of three finals.
E · Writing · Example
⁧نَاقَشَ بَرْنَامَجٌ حِوَارِيٌّ لُبْنَانِيٌّ أَوْضَاعَ المَدَارِسِ الرَّسْمِيَّةِ، بِمُشَارَكَةِ مُدِيرِ مَدْرَسَةٍ وَمُمَثِّلَةٍ عَنْ لَجْنَةِ الأَهَالِي.⁩
⁧وَأَوْضَحَ المُدِيرُ أَنَّ أَرْبَعِينَ فِي المِئَةِ مِنَ الأَسَاتِذَةِ مُتَعَاقِدُونَ وَأَنَّ رَوَاتِبَهُمْ لَا تَكْفِي، مُشِيرًا إِلَى أَنَّ كَثِيرِينَ⁩
⁧مِنْهُمُ انْتَقَلُوا إِلَى المَدَارِسِ الخَاصَّةِ. فِي المُقَابِلِ، رَأَتْ مُمَثِّلَةُ الأَهَالِي أَنَّ المُشْكِلَةَ لَا تَقْتَصِرُ عَلَى الرَّوَاتِبِ، إِذْ لَمْ⁩
⁧تَعُدِ الأُسَرُ قَادِرَةً عَلَى دَفْعِ أَقْسَاطِ المَدَارِسِ الخَاصَّةِ، مَا أَدَّى إِلَى وُجُودِ أَرْبَعِينَ تِلْمِيذًا فِي الصَّفِّ الوَاحِدِ.⁩
⁧وَاعْتَبَرَ المُدِيرُ أَنَّ غِيَابَ المِيزَانِيَّةِ يَحُولُ دُونَ أَيِّ حَلٍّ، فِيمَا طَالَبَتِ المُمَثِّلَةُ بِخُطَّةٍ مِنَ الوِزَارَةِ بَدَلًا مِنَ الوُعُودِ.⁩
⁧وَاتَّفَقَ الطَّرَفَانِ فِي الخِتَامِ عَلَى أَنَّ الحَلَّ بِيَدِ الوِزَارَةِ.⁩

Points to check: same space on both sides; Neutral verbs ( ⁧أوضح، رأى، اعتبر، طالب⁩ ); the two digits (40% of contract teachers, 40 pupils per class); the outcome (agreement on ministry responsibility); No assessment.
